question: Should crabpot accept the Clawmetry release range containing standalone-node OAuth and related runtime changes as its new external fixture pin?
rationale: The repository’s one-line gitlink diff cannot establish whether the upstream OAuth and runtime behavior changes are compatible with the fixture’s intended boundary; accepting that external behavior change is a maintainer security and compatibility judgment.

options.title: Audit and accept the release pin
options.body: Review the upstream compare and accept the upgrade if its OAuth and runtime changes are compatible with this fixture’s intended test surface.

options.title: Pause the pin update
options.body: Leave the current pin in place until the upstream release range can be reviewed or narrowed to a known-compatible revision.
